taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.

controls.boundary: Mobile local data, backup and retention exposure — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Map sensitive files/databases/preferences, backups, logs, clipboard/snapshots and cache lifecycle. Define the attacker device state: ordinary app, unlocked user, backup access or compromised device.
controls.controlled_verification: Use synthetic account markers on an owned test device/build. Follow one sensitive value into its stored copies and compare access in the prohibited versus intended device/account state. Test logout/account switch against the declared retention policy.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Reading files on a rooted/jailbroken device does not establish access by an ordinary app. Encryption at rest does not by itself protect data after the legitimate process decrypts it.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Apply appropriate platform storage/protection and lifecycle cleanup for the actual threat model. Retest required offline/background use and the original unintended access/retention path.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
